op_en: Both conclusions I and II follow
q_en:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:
All curtains are blinders.
All blinders are masks.
Some masks are scarves.

Conclusions:
(I) No blinder is a scarf.
(II) All curtains are masks.5727

DEN HUT FOR ASK

‘touch the ground’ is coded as ‘ni na ne’,

What is the code for ‘see’?

(Left) 364 792 173 951 627 (Right)
(Example : 697 – First digit = 6, Second digit = 9 and third digit = 7)
(Note: All operations to be done from left to right.)

If all the numbers are arranged in ascending order, position of how many numbers will remain unchanged?5739

E, F, K, L, R and S live on six different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it is numbered 2 and so on till the topmost floor, which is numbered 6. E lives on an even-numbered floor but not on floor number 4. Only two people live between E and K. F lives on an odd numbered floor but not on the lowermost floor. Only two people live between F and L. S lives immediately below F. How many people live between R and S?

Statement:
N = K < L ≤ G = B > T

Conclusions:
I. B > N

U is sitting third to the left of R. How many people are sitting between P and T when counted from the left of P?

(Left) D @ 3 A G & T 2 R Y # & % 7 4 @ 6 K & # E 5 * S (Right)

How many such numbers are there each of which is immediately preceded by a symbol and also immediately followed by a letter or a number?

Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U, and V has an exam on a different day of a week, starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week.
T has an exam on Wednesday. Only two people have exams between P and T. R has an exam after Q, but before T. S has an exam immediately before V.
On which day does U have the exam?

How many such symbols are there each of which is immediately preceded by a number and also immediately followed by a number?
